title: LOTUS: A Leaderboard for Detailed Image Captioning from Quality to Societal Bias and User Preferences

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating performance disparity across detailed image captioning metrics for binary gender image groups (woman vs. man) and evaluating the disparity in the usage of gender-specific terms in the generated captions.

Calculating performance disparity across detailed image captioning metrics for binary skin tone categories (darker-skin vs. lighter-skin) and measuring the disparity in the usage of race-related terms in the generated captions.
Measuring the performance disparity (language discrepancy) in detailed image captioning when models are prompted in different languages (English, Japanese, and Chinese).
